package courseclient

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"sync/atomic"
	"testing"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/usecase/answer"
)

type deniedDiagnosticAssignment struct{}

func (deniedDiagnosticAssignment) CanAccessCourse(context.Context, string, string) (bool, error) {
	return false, nil
}

const catalogCourseID = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"

func diagnosticCatalogPayload() map[string]any {
	p := map[string]any{"schema": "course-diagnostic-assessment-catalog.v1", "course_id": catalogCourseID, "curriculum_revision": "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("a", 64)}
	lessons := make([]any, 0, 3)
	for i := 0; i < 3; i++ {
		lessonID := "22222222-2222-4222-8222-22222222222" + string(rune('0'+i))
		lessons = append(lessons, map[string]any{"id": lessonID, "course_id": catalogCourseID, "status": 1, "order": i, "tasks": []any{map[string]any{"id": "33333333-3333-4333-8333-33333333333" + string(rune('0'+i)), "lesson_id": lessonID, "type": 11, "assessment_purpose": "diagnostic", "evaluation_mode": "AUTO", "version": 1, "status": 1, "updated_at": "2026-01-02T00:00:00Z", "order": i, "learning_targets": []any{map[string]any{"type": "concept", "key": "go.syntax", "version": "v1"}}}}})
	}
	p["lessons"] = lessons
	return p
}

func TestDiagnosticCatalogValidExactNestedCourseProjection(t *testing.T) {
	payload := diagnosticCatalogPayload()
	body, _ := json.Marshal(payload)
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		if r.Header.Get("X-Internal-Token") != "catalog-token" {
			t.Errorf("token missing")
		}
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		_, _ = w.Write(body)
	}))
	defer server.Close()
	got, err := (DiagnosticCatalogClient{BaseURL: server.URL, InternalToken: "catalog-token", HTTPClient: server.Client()}).GetDiagnosticAssessmentCatalog(context.Background(), catalogCourseID)
	if err != nil || got.Schema != "course-diagnostic-assessment-catalog.v1" || got.CourseID != catalogCourseID || len(got.Items) != 3 || got.Items[0].AssessmentPurpose != "diagnostic" || got.Items[0].Type != 11 {
		t.Fatalf("catalog=%+v err=%v", got, err)
	}
}

func TestDiagnosticCatalogRejectsMalformedNestedSchemaAndBounds(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []struct {
		name   string
		mutate func(map[string]any)
	}{
		{"schema", func(p map[string]any) { p["schema"] = "other" }}, {"course", func(p map[string]any) { p["course_id"] = "aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa" }}, {"revision", func(p map[string]any) { p["curriculum_revision"] = "sha256:ABC" }},
		{"empty", func(p map[string]any) { p["lessons"] = []any{} }}, {"negative order", func(p map[string]any) { p["lessons"].([]any)[0].(map[string]any)["order"] = -1 }}, {"wrong status", func(p map[string]any) { p["lessons"].([]any)[0].(map[string]any)["status"] = 0 }},
		{"wrong purpose", func(p map[string]any) {
			p["lessons"].([]any)[0].(map[string]any)["tasks"].([]any)[0].(map[string]any)["assessment_purpose"] = "practice"
		}}, {"wrong type", func(p map[string]any) {
			p["lessons"].([]any)[0].(map[string]any)["tasks"].([]any)[0].(map[string]any)["type"] = 1
		}},
		{"wrong evaluation mode", func(p map[string]any) {
			p["lessons"].([]any)[0].(map[string]any)["tasks"].([]any)[0].(map[string]any)["evaluation_mode"] = "MANUAL"
		}}, {"wrong evaluation mode type", func(p map[string]any) {
			p["lessons"].([]any)[0].(map[string]any)["tasks"].([]any)[0].(map[string]any)["evaluation_mode"] = 1
		}},
		{"unknown", func(p map[string]any) { p["private_answer_key"] = "secret" }},
	}
	for _, tc := range tests {
		p := diagnosticCatalogPayload()
		tc.mutate(p)
		body, _ := json.Marshal(p)
		server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) {
			w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
			_, _ = w.Write(body)
		}))
		_, err := (DiagnosticCatalogClient{BaseURL: server.URL, InternalToken: "x", HTTPClient: server.Client()}).GetDiagnosticAssessmentCatalog(context.Background(), catalogCourseID)
		server.Close()
		if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) {
			t.Errorf("%s err=%v", tc.name, err)
		}
	}
	duplicate := diagnosticCatalogPayload()
	duplicate["lessons"].([]any)[1].(map[string]any)["tasks"].([]any)[0].(map[string]any)["id"] = duplicate["lessons"].([]any)[0].(map[string]any)["tasks"].([]any)[0].(map[string]any)["id"]
	body, _ := json.Marshal(duplicate)
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) {
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		_, _ = w.Write(body)
	}))
	_, err := (DiagnosticCatalogClient{BaseURL: server.URL, InternalToken: "x", HTTPClient: server.Client()}).GetDiagnosticAssessmentCatalog(context.Background(), catalogCourseID)
	server.Close()
	if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) {
		t.Fatalf("duplicate err=%v", err)
	}
	tooMany := diagnosticCatalogPayload()
	items := tooMany["lessons"].([]any)
	for i := 0; i < 501; i++ {
		items = append(items, items[0])
	}
	tooMany["lessons"] = items
	body, _ = json.Marshal(tooMany)
	server = httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) {
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		_, _ = w.Write(body)
	}))
	_, err = (DiagnosticCatalogClient{BaseURL: server.URL, InternalToken: "x", HTTPClient: server.Client()}).GetDiagnosticAssessmentCatalog(context.Background(), catalogCourseID)
	server.Close()
	if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) {
		t.Fatalf("too many err=%v", err)
	}
}

func TestDiagnosticCatalogRejectsMediaTrailingAndOversize(t *testing.T) {
	for _, tc := range []struct{ name, media, body string }{{"media", "text/plain", `{}`}, {"trailing", "application/json", string(mustJSON(diagnosticCatalogPayload())) + " {}"}, {"oversize", "application/json", strings.Repeat("x", (1<<20)+1)}} {
		server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) {
			w.Header().Set("Content-Type", tc.media)
			_, _ = w.Write([]byte(tc.body))
		}))
		_, err := (DiagnosticCatalogClient{BaseURL: server.URL, InternalToken: "x", HTTPClient: server.Client()}).GetDiagnosticAssessmentCatalog(context.Background(), catalogCourseID)
		server.Close()
		if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) {
			t.Errorf("%s err=%v", tc.name, err)
		}
	}
}
func mustJSON(v any) []byte { b, _ := json.Marshal(v); return b }

func TestGetTaskRedirectNeverContactsTargetOrForwardsInternalToken(t *testing.T) {
	var targetCalls atomic.Int32
	target := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		targetCalls.Add(1)
		if r.Header.Get("X-Internal-Token") != "" {
			t.Errorf("token forwarded")
		}
		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
	}))
	defer target.Close()
	source := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		http.Redirect(w, r, target.URL+"/internal/task/get-internal-task/"+r.URL.Path[strings.LastIndex(r.URL.Path, "/")+1:], http.StatusFound)
	}))
	defer source.Close()
	_, err := (Client{BaseURL: source.URL, InternalToken: "secret", HTTPClient: source.Client()}).GetTask(context.Background(), "task-id")
	if err == nil || targetCalls.Load() != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("redirect err=%v target_calls=%d", err, targetCalls.Load())
	}
}

func TestDiagnosticCatalogRedirectNeverContactsTargetOrForwardsToken(t *testing.T) {
	var targetCalls atomic.Int32
	target := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		targetCalls.Add(1)
		if r.Header.Get("X-Internal-Token") != "" {
			t.Errorf("catalog token forwarded to redirect target")
		}
		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
	}))
	defer target.Close()
	source := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		http.Redirect(w, r, target.URL+"/catalog", http.StatusFound)
	}))
	defer source.Close()
	_, err := (DiagnosticCatalogClient{BaseURL: source.URL, InternalToken: "catalog-secret", HTTPClient: source.Client()}).GetDiagnosticAssessmentCatalog(context.Background(), catalogCourseID)
	if err == nil || targetCalls.Load() != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("catalog redirect err=%v target_calls=%d", err, targetCalls.Load())
	}
}

func TestDiagnosticCatalogRejectsNonCanonicalRequestedCourseID(t *testing.T) {
	if _, err := (DiagnosticCatalogClient{BaseURL: "http://127.0.0.1", InternalToken: "x"}).GetDiagnosticAssessmentCatalog(context.Background(), " "+catalogCourseID); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("whitespace course ID accepted")
	}
}

func TestDiagnosticTaskBypassesOnlyPublicAssignmentGate(t *testing.T) {
	taskID := "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333"
	lessonID := "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
	var publicCalls, internalCalls atomic.Int32
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		if strings.HasPrefix(r.URL.Path, "/api/v1/task/get/") {
			publicCalls.Add(1)
			w.WriteHeader(http.StatusForbidden)
			return
		}
		if strings.HasPrefix(r.URL.Path, "/internal/task/get-internal-task/") {
			internalCalls.Add(1)
			w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
			_, _ = w.Write([]byte(`{"id":"` + taskID + `","lesson_id":"` + lessonID + `","course_id":"` + catalogCourseID + `","status":1,"type":11,"evaluation_mode":"AUTO","assessment_purpose":"diagnostic","version":1,"updated_at":"2026-01-02T00:00:00Z","learning_targets":[{"type":"concept","key":"go.syntax","version":"v1"}]}`))
			return
		}
		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNotFound)
	}))
	defer server.Close()
	client := Client{BaseURL: server.URL, InternalToken: "ordinary", HTTPClient: server.Client(), AssignmentAccess: deniedDiagnosticAssignment{}}
	ctx := answer.WithPublicContentAccessAudience(context.Background(), "", "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", "STUDENT")
	if _, err := client.GetTask(ctx, taskID); !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrForbidden) {
		t.Fatalf("ordinary err=%v internal=%d", err, internalCalls.Load())
	}
	if _, err := client.GetDiagnosticTask(ctx, taskID); err != nil || publicCalls.Load() != 1 || internalCalls.Load() != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("diagnostic err=%v public=%d internal=%d", err, publicCalls.Load(), internalCalls.Load())
	}
}

func TestDiagnosticTaskAcceptsKnownCoursePrivateProjectionAndResolvesCourseFromLesson(t *testing.T) {
	taskID := "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333"
	lessonID := "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		switch r.URL.Path {
		case "/internal/task/get-internal-task/" + taskID:
			_, _ = w.Write([]byte(`{"id":"` + taskID + `","lesson_id":"` + lessonID + `","title":"Diagnostic","description":"","translations":[],"learning_targets":[{"type":"concept","key":"go.syntax","version":"v1"}],"code_structure_type_id":"00000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000f900","code_structure_type_code":"TEST_SINGLE_CHOICE_BASIC","code_structure":{"test":{"mode":"single_choice"}},"compose_config":null,"type":11,"assessment_purpose":"diagnostic","task_kind":"test","execution_mode":"NO_RUN","evaluation_mode":"AUTO","ui_mode":"QUIZ","submission_mode":"ANSWER_PAYLOAD","requires_sandbox":false,"exposes_preview":false,"exposes_terminal":false,"supports_live_validation":false,"allowed_errors_count":0,"order":0,"status":1,"version":1,"created_at":"2026-01-01T00:00:00Z","updated_at":"2026-01-02T00:00:00Z","tests":[{"id":"44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444","source_key":"diagnostic.question","task_id":"` + taskID + `","kind":"single_choice","title":"Question","description":"","translations":[],"order":1,"variants":[{"id":"55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555","source_key":"diagnostic.answer","task_test_id":"44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444","text":"Answer","is_correct":true,"translations":[],"order":1},{"id":"66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666","source_key":"diagnostic.wrong","task_test_id":"44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444","text":"Wrong","is_correct":false,"translations":[],"order":2}]}]}`))
		case "/internal/lesson/get-internal-lesson/" + lessonID:
			_, _ = w.Write([]byte(`{"id":"` + lessonID + `","course_id":"` + catalogCourseID + `","title":"Lesson","excerpt":"","description":"","order":0,"status":1}`))
		default:
			w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNotFound)
		}
	}))
	defer server.Close()
	task, err := (Client{BaseURL: server.URL, InternalToken: "token", HTTPClient: server.Client()}).GetDiagnosticTask(context.Background(), taskID)
	if err != nil || task == nil || task.CourseID != catalogCourseID || len(task.Tests) != 1 || len(task.Tests[0].Variants) != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("diagnostic task = %#v, err=%v", task, err)
	}
}

func TestDiagnosticTaskFailsClosedOnUnsafeWire(t *testing.T) {
	taskID := "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333"
	lessonID := "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
	valid := `{"id":"` + taskID + `","lesson_id":"` + lessonID + `","course_id":"` + catalogCourseID + `","status":1,"type":11,"evaluation_mode":"AUTO","assessment_purpose":"diagnostic","version":1,"updated_at":"2026-01-02T00:00:00Z","learning_targets":[{"type":"concept","key":"go.syntax","version":"v1"}]}`
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name, media, body string
		status            int
	}{
		{"media", "text/plain", valid, http.StatusOK}, {"unknown", "application/json", valid[:len(valid)-1] + `,"private":"x"}`, http.StatusOK},
		{"trailing", "application/json", valid + ` {}`, http.StatusOK}, {"manual", "application/json", strings.Replace(valid, `"AUTO"`, `"MANUAL"`, 1), http.StatusOK}, {"created", "application/json", valid, http.StatusCreated}, {"no content", "application/json", valid, http.StatusNoContent}, {"redirect", "application/json", "", http.StatusFound},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
				w.Header().Set("Content-Type", tc.media)
				if tc.status == http.StatusFound {
					w.Header().Set("Location", "http://example.invalid")
					w.WriteHeader(tc.status)
					return
				}
				w.WriteHeader(tc.status)
				_, _ = w.Write([]byte(tc.body))
			}))
			defer server.Close()
			if _, err := (Client{BaseURL: server.URL, InternalToken: "x", HTTPClient: server.Client()}).GetDiagnosticTask(context.Background(), taskID); err == nil {
				t.Fatal("unsafe diagnostic task accepted")
			}
		})
	}
	if _, err := (Client{BaseURL: "http://127.0.0.1", InternalToken: "x"}).GetDiagnosticTask(context.Background(), " "+taskID); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("noncanonical task ID accepted")
	}
	if _, err := (Client{BaseURL: "http://127.0.0.1"}).GetDiagnosticTask(context.Background(), taskID); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("empty diagnostic token accepted")
	}
}
